'''Trilaser Cannons''' were a form of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted [[Laser/Legends|laser]] weaponry. [[Discril-class attack cruiser|''Discril''-class attack cruiser]] were armed with two Trilaser Cannons.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
